arxiv-2102-02093.title: Analysis of trophic networks: an optimisation approach
arxiv-2102-02093.creator: Jean-Guy Caputo, Valerie Girardin, Arnaud Knippel, Hieu Nguyen, Nathalie Niquil, Quentin Noguès
arxiv-2102-02093.description: Abstract We introduce a methodology to study the possible matter flows of an ecosystem defined by observational biomass data and realistic biological constraints. The flows belong to a polyhedron in a multi dimensional space making statistical exploration difficult in practice; instead, we propose to solve a convex optimization problem.

arxiv-2109-01727.title: Increasing Adversarial Uncertainty to Scale Private Similarity Testing
arxiv-2109-01727.creator: Yiqing Hua, Armin Namavari, Kaishuo Cheng, Mor Naaman, Thomas Ristenpart
arxiv-2109-01727.description: Abstract Social media and other platforms rely on automated detection of abusive content to help combat disinformation, harassment, and abuse. One common approach is to check user content for similarity against a server-side database of problematic items. However, this method fundamentally endangers user privacy.

arxiv-2212-02967.title: RISnet: a Dedicated Scalable Neural Network Architecture for Optimization of Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
arxiv-2212-02967.creator: Bile Peng, Finn Siegismund-Poschmann, Eduard A. Jorswieck
arxiv-2212-02967.description: Abstract The reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) is a promising technology for next-generation wireless communication. It comprises many passive antennas, which reflect signals from the transmitter to the receiver with adjusted phases without changing the amplitude. The large number of the antennas enables a huge potential of signal processing despite the simple functionality of a single antenna.

arxiv-2302-10089.title: On the uniqueness of co-circular four body central configurations
arxiv-2302-10089.creator: Manuele Santoprete
arxiv-2302-10089.description: Abstract We study central configurations lying on a common circle in the Newtonian four-body problem. Using a topological argument we prove that there is at most one co-circular central configuration for each cyclic ordering of the masses on the circle.

arxiv-2311-05678.title: Cool dark sector, concordance, and a low 𝝈 𝟖 \sigma_{8}
arxiv-2311-05678.creator: Ellie Hughes, Fei Ge, Francis-Yan Cyr-Racine, Lloyd Knox, Srinivasan Raghunathan
arxiv-2311-05678.description: Abstract We investigate a cosmological model in which a fraction of the dark matter is atomic dark matter (ADM). This ADM consists of dark versions of the electron and of the proton, interacting with each other and with dark photons just as their light sector versions do, but interacting with everything else only gravitationally.

According to the famous Weyl law, both its Dirichlet eigenvalue λ k ​ ( Ω ) \lambda_{k}(\Omega) and its Neumann eigenvalue μ k ​ ( Ω ) \mu_{k}(\Omega) have the same leading asymptotics w k ​ ( Ω ) = C ⁡ ( d , Ω ) ​ k 2 / d w_{k}(\Omega)=C(d,\Omega)k^{2/d} as k → ∞ k\to\infty .

arxiv-2410-02329.title: AirTags for Human Localization, Not Just Objects
arxiv-2410-02329.creator: Mohamed I. Hany, Hamada Rizk, Moustafa Youssef
arxiv-2410-02329.description: Abstract Indoor localization has become increasingly important due to its wide-ranging applications in indoor navigation, emergency services, the IoT ( IoT ), and accessibility for individuals with special needs. Traditional localization systems often require extensive calibration to achieve high accuracy.

arxiv-2412-17097.title: On the extension of one-parameter operator semigroups to completions of Archimedean vector lattices
arxiv-2412-17097.description: Abstract Extensions of one-parameter operator semigroups on Archimedean vector lattices to their order/ru-completions are studied. Existence and uniqueness of the extension to the ru-completion is established in the class of positive semigroups. An extension theorem for positive ru-continuos semigroups on vector lattices with property (R) is proved.

arxiv-2506-02981.title: Astrophotography Turbulence Mitigation via Generative Models
arxiv-2506-02981.creator: Joonyeoup Kim, Yu Yuan, Xingguang Zhang, Xijun Wang, Stanley Chan
arxiv-2506-02981.description: Abstract Photography is the cornerstone of modern astronomical and space research. However, most astronomical images captured by ground-based telescopes suffer from atmospheric turbulence, resulting in degraded imaging quality. While multi-frame strategies like lucky imaging can mitigate some effects, they involve intensive data acquisition and complex manual processing.

arxiv-2506-06206.title: Initial stage jet momentum broadening in tBLFQ formalism
arxiv-2506-06206.creator: \firstname Dana \lastname Avramescu \fnsep, \firstname Carlos \lastname Lamas \fnsep, \firstname Tuomas \lastname Lappi \fnsep, \firstname Meijian \lastname Li \fnsep, \firstname Carlos \lastname A. Salgado \fnsep
arxiv-2506-06206.description: Abstract We study the momentum broadening of a high-energy quark jet in the large density gluon medium created right after the collision of two ultrarelativistic heavy nuclei, the Glasma. Previous Glasma studies modeled the jet as a classical probe particle, for which position and momentum are simultaneously determined.

It is situated in an extremely fertile plain, and is completely surrounded with olive groves, the produce of which is reckoned the finest oil of all Syria; and its position on the carriage-road from Aleppo to Aintab and Birejik gives it importance. The population (20,000) consists largely of Circassians, Turkomans and Arabs, the town lying just on the northern rim of the Arab territory.

pmc-10583212.title: Strongly Bound Polynuclear Anions Comprising Scandium Fluoride Building Blocks
pmc-10583212.creator: Iwona Anusiewicz, Piotr Skurski
pmc-10583212.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The stability of polynuclear anions composed of ScF3 building blocks was studied by using ab initio and density functional theory electronic structure methods and flexible basis sets. Thorough exploration of ground state potential energy surfaces of (Sc2F7)−, (Sc3F10)−, and (Sc4F13)− anions which may be viewed as comprising ScF3 fragments and the additional fluorine atom led to determining the isomeric structures thereof.

pmc-10609408.title: Total Flavonoids from Camellia oleifera Alleviated Mycoplasma pneumoniae-Induced Lung Injury via Inhibition of the TLR2-Mediated NF-κB and MAPK Pathways
pmc-10609408.creator: Nan Ding, Aihua Lei, Zhisheng Shi, Lin Xiang, Bo Wei, Yimou Wu, Irwin Rose Alencar Menezes, Henrique Douglas Melo Coutinho, Almir Gonçalves Wanderley, Jaime Ribeiro-Filho
pmc-10609408.description: Mycoplasma pneumoniae (M. pneumoniae) is an atypical bacterial pathogen responsible for community-acquired pneumonia primarily among school-aged children and young adults. Camellia oleifera (C. oleifera) has been used as a medicinal and edible plant in China for centuries, the constituents from which possessed various bioactivities. Notably, flavonoids existing in residues of C. oleifera defatted seeds exhibited significant anti-inflammatory activities.

pmc-11439053.title: The urotensin II receptor triggers an early meningeal response and a delayed macrophage-dependent vasospasm after subarachnoid hemorrhage in male mice
pmc-11439053.creator: Martin Pedard, Lucie Prevost, Camille Carpena, Brian Holleran, Laurence Desrues, Martine Dubois, Celeste Nicola, Roxane Gruel, David Godefroy, Thomas Deffieux, Mickael Tanter, Carine Ali, Richard Leduc, Laurent Prézeau, Pierrick Gandolfo, Fabrice Morin, Olivier Wurtz, Thomas Bonnard, Denis Vivien, H
pmc-11439053.description: Subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) can be associated with neurological deficits and has profound consequences for mortality and morbidity. Cerebral vasospasm (CVS) and delayed cerebral ischemia affect neurological outcomes in SAH patients, but their mechanisms are not fully understood, and effective treatments are limited.

pmc-11470564.title: Study of the synergistic effect of analogical and explicit learning in beginning junior tennis players
pmc-11470564.creator: Jiyan Xu, Weiwei Xu, Mengjiao Sang
pmc-11470564.description: Motor skill learning is a field where implicit and explicit synergistic learning is particularly evident in authentic situations. While current research on analogical learning, an effective method of implicit learning, is largely focused on theoretical discussions and separability studies, there are relatively few studies that combine analogical learning with explicit learning.

pmc-11647757.title: Controllable All-in-One Biomimetic Hollow Nanoscaffold Initiating Pyroptosis-Mediated Antiosteosarcoma Targeted Therapy and Bone Defect Repair
pmc-11647757.creator: Qiming Ma, Shenglin Xu, Qian Wang, Yukang Que, Peng He, Rui Yang, Hao Wang, Ziheng Wu, Longze Xiao, Xingshi Yuan, Xingxing Li, Tangbing Xu, Yong Hu
pmc-11647757.description: Pyroptosis has gained attention for its potential to reinvigorate the immune system within the tumor microenvironment. However, current approaches employing pyroptosis inducers suffer from limitations. They primarily rely on single agents, lack precise targeting, and potentially disrupt the intricate bone formation microenvironment, hindering local repair of tumor-induced bone defects.

pmc-12603552.title: Bronchodilator response as an independent predictor of severity in bronchiectasis
pmc-12603552.creator: Yu Ri Kang, Hyun Lee, Hayoung Choi, Seung Won Ra, Yeon-Mok Oh, Ki Hyun Seo, Jae Sung Choi, Ho Sung Lee, Jiwon Lyu, Jihye Lee, Jin-Young Kim, Kyeong-Deok Kim, Ju Ock Na
pmc-12603552.description: BackgroundBronchodilator response (BDR) is occasionally observed in patients with bronchiectasis. However, clinical implications of BDR of bronchiectasis remain unclear. This multicenter observational cohort study aimed to compare clinical characteristics and severity in bronchiectasis between patients with BDR and without BDR.

pmc-12614578.title: A novel image encryption framework using Wireworld cellular automaton and hybrid chaotic maps for enhanced security
pmc-12614578.creator: Bayan Alabdullah, Hadeel Alsolai, Fatimah Alhayan, Atif Ikram, Abrar Almjally, Mohammad Shehab, Marwan Ali Albahar
pmc-12614578.description: The generation, storage, and transmission of digital images have become ubiquitous in today’s interconnected world. Ensuring the security of these images is a critical challenge that demands immediate attention. This study proposes a novel image encryption algorithm designed to address these concerns effectively.

pmc-12672912.title: Molecular transmission network analysis of newly diagnosed HIV-1 infections in Ningbo from 2018–2022
pmc-12672912.creator: Yue-Qi Yin, Yu-Hui Liu, Jing Zhu, Peng Shen, Yun-Peng Chen, Zhi-Qin Jiang, Hong-Bo Lin, Hong-Xia Ni, Ye-Xiang Sun
pmc-12672912.description: IntroductionUnderstanding molecular transmission patterns is critical for HIV prevention designed with key populations. This study aimed to characterize the molecular epidemiology, transmission networks, and underlying factors associated with HIV-1 transmission in Ningbo during 2018–2022.MethodsWe analyzed data from 1,409 newly diagnosed people living with HIV who had successful genotyping.

pmc-13276759.title: Prevalence and associated factors of head lice (Pediculus humanus capitis) among schoolchildren in Mérida (Yucatán) and Monterrey (Nuevo León), Mexico
pmc-13276759.creator: Iram P Rodriguez-Sanchez, Mariana Lizbeth Jiménez Martínez, María de Lourdes Ramírez Ahuja, Felipe A Dzul-Manzanilla, Fabian Correa-Morales, Adriana E Flores, Sergio Dzib, Norma Pavia, Pablo Manrique-Saide, Gerardo Trujillo-Rodríguez
pmc-13276759.description: Pediculosis capitis is a common parasitic infestation in school settings and can disrupt wellbeing and school attendance. Despite its public-health relevance, epidemiological data describing Pediculosis capitis prevalence and associated factors in Mexico remain limited at the city level. This study aimed to estimate the prevalence of Pediculosis capitis and identify associated factors among schoolchildren from Monterrey and Mérida, Mexico.

pmc-13594022.creator: Kenneth J Malmberg, Amy H Criss
pmc-13594022.description: We comment on an article by Shiffrin, Stigler, and Keil (2026) relating illusory beliefs of understanding to hubris, discussing the dangers associated with accepting a model as a lawful fact and the benefits of questioning one’s models. Hubris is the greatest danger that accompanies formal data analysis - J.W. Tukey.

pmc-13687166.creator: Linda Grüßer, András Keszei, Rolf Rossaint, Berit Zingraf, Julia Wallqvist, Sebastian Goldmann, Mark Coburn, Andreas Güldner, Thomas Hachenberg, Christian Hönemann, Thea Koch, Bert Mierke, Martin Schuster, Hermann Wrigge, Julia Schuler, Jan Larmann, Ana Kowark, NO-HARM Study Group, German Society of
pmc-13687166.description: PurposeIntraoperative lung protective ventilation and, in inhalational anesthesia, minimal fresh gas flow (FGF) are recommended. It remains unclear how these recommendations are transferred to clinical routine. We aimed to assess corresponding anesthesia practices in Germany and raise awareness of optimal ventilation settings.
